en: • The only red member of the △ platoon who played a big role in the latest work "Macross △"! VF-31C Mirage machine is now available as a 1/72 Scale three-stage transformation model!!
• Achieve optimal proportions for each form! Equipped with a locking mechanism that allows stable posing in each form!!
• Comes with a wealth of optional parts such as figures, landing gear, and various armed parts!!
